links.surface: أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَرْقِیِّ

notes: The first «أبي» is the compiler's own father, named by relation only, so it is a relation link.
«أبيه» after the Barqi name is the father who raises the hadith («يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِیثَ»), the last link before the Prophet; no unnamed gap is written.
«ره» is an honorific and is left out.

levels.surface: أحمد بن أبي عبد الله البرقي

notes: «يَرْفَعُ الْحَدِيثَ» attributes the saying to the Prophet; it is not an unnamed gap (rule 8), and the Prophet ends the chain
The first «أبي» is the compiler's father (the compiler heads the chain), written as a relation
